items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: They used to rehearse out to Milt Senior's house... And just two saxophones, just Milt Senior and Wesley Stewart.

ctx.x: What was the first, your first interest in getting to hear an orchestra where you figured you wanted to play in an orchestra? How did you get to there?
Well, McKinney had a band called Synco Cinco Septet. They only had seven pieces. And they used to rehearse out to Milt Senior's house, you know.
